matchups.preview: Rilind's about to learn the hard way that reaching for your "guy" in round three doesn't make him your guy, while Rob's out here playing 4D chess with a roster that screams "I drafted hungover and didn't check my lineup once all preseason." This is gonna be a bloodbath of missed starts and reach picks, and honestly we're all just here to watch who chokes harder.

Look, we've got two teams that haven't thrown a punch yet, and already you can smell the desperation—Jetmir and Peter are probably gonna spend this whole week arguing about who gets blamed when their receivers drop 47 balls, while Adam's out here banking on the same "wait till next week" energy that's gonna carry him straight to the toilet bowl by October. One of these teams is walking away with an L, and honestly, both of them look equally capable of finding new and creative ways to fuck it up.

Ilir's about to learn the hard way that one good draft day doesn't mean shit when you panic-trade half your roster by Week 4, while Rinor's sitting there with a team held together by duct tape and desperation picks that screamed "I wasn't paying attention." Two teams with zero wins and even less self-awareness about to go to war -- somebody's losing their first game this week, and honestly, both of you deserve it.

Faton's about to learn why his draft strategy of "just pick whoever sounds intimidating" is already in shambles, while Flamur's roster full of late-round lottery tickets that won't hit until November gets exposed Week 1. One of you dipshits is walking out of this looking competent—spoiler alert, it ain't gonna happen for either of you.

Veton's rolling out Week 1 looking like he actually studied film for once, but we all know that confidence is gonna evaporate faster than his playoff hopes by Week 6 when his "sleeper" picks turn out to be straight-up narcoleptic. Arben's out here acting like last season's dumpster fire never happened, but you can't rebuild a championship team when you keep making the same dipshit draft decisions—this matchup is gonna be a clinic in mutual incompetence, and honestly we're just here to see who fucks up worse first.

Ben's out here acting like he cracked the draft code with that mid-round reach on a running back who can't stay healthy, meanwhile Nori's banking on a collection of "upside plays" that have all the upside of a screen door on a submarine. This week's gonna be a bloodbath between two teams that look like they were assembled by a guy who fell asleep during his mocks and woke up panicking.
